rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase, 3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027 (1.6%)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of base rent. The prior year's (3/1/2025 - 2/28/2026) allowable increase was 1.4%.
rules.key_value: 1.6% annual allowable increase for 3/1/2026-2/28/2027 (multiply base rent by .016; e.g., $2,000 base rent -> $32.00 increase -> $2,032.00); prior year 1.4%

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco; the document does not define coverage beyond 'rent-controlled units'.
coverage.other_conditions: Applies to units subject to the rent control ordinance (rent-controlled units).

rules.effective_date_note: Rate applies for the March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 period; announcement dated January 14, 2026.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.review_note: The document does not name the governing ordinance; the Admin. Code ch. 37 citation is inferred from the Rent Board and rent-controlled units context. Coverage details are not stated.
